title: A Lesson in Disorder
coreMove: Use small disorder to discover fit where tidy planning would only preserve assumptions.
sourcePressure: This chapter treats bounded mess, trial, and self-discovery as informative in uncertain life.

sourceAnchors.name: a lesson in disorder
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter uses disorder as a source of self-discovery when bounded
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The mess has to be small enough to teach before it can claim to be a lesson.

sourceAnchors.name: fit discovery
sourceAnchors.detail: source notes frame trial and bounded mess as ways to find fit
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Fit is often found by bumping into the edge, not by naming it in advance.

hook: opening by explaining A Lesson in Disorder
tryThisNow: make a pros and cons list with no exposure map

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
